name: Suzushiro Aoi
source: The older woman who rejected Yuki in the cruelest way possible and caused his fear of women.  She is without intentional malice, but she is also a slut who enjoys light relationships that are mostly about sex.  She has no common sense, which caused her problems with her little sister.  However, she is unaware/uncomprehending when it comes to this reality.
